collectionunit.notes: Eijelkamp corer was used to extract the first 1m. Remaining core sections were extracted using the Livingstone piston sampler.
collectionunit.collectiondevice: Eijelkamp monolith sampler and Livingstone piston sampler

site.sitedescription: Stunted pines grow on hummocks with Vaccinium myrtillus, Calluna vulgaris, Molinia caerulea, Juncus spp., Carex echinata, Potentilla erecta and Sphagnum spp. The lawns are characterised by Sphagnum spp., Carex spp., Erica tetralix, Drosera spp. and Agrostis stolonifera. In shallow pools Carex spp, Menyanthes trifoliata and Potamogeton spp. are found.
